metrics.notes: 44 distinct identifiable employers/companies were individually surfaced from current HH commercial/sales leadership listings. Obvious recruiters, anonymous employers, public/state/very large unsuitable companies, duplicate employer rows and non-signal roles were rejected at FAST GATE. Four strongest low-overlap candidates received deeper legal/scale/signal/LPR/contact checks. DokaGene was not staged because a sufficiently current direct job signal was not confirmed in this pass. Albes Met was not staged because current scale is 12.312bn RUB revenue and the candidate was not strong enough against the target profile to justify inclusion. No rows were counted merely from a search-result total.
